#### List:

#### Summary:

+------------------------+-------------------------------+
| Objectives             | - Support foetal gas exchange |
|                        | - Prepare for massive PPH     |
+------------------------+-------------------------------+
| Most important changes | - ↑Blood volume               |
|                        | - ↑Interstitial volume        |
|                        | - ↑Cardiac output             |
|                        | - ↑Coagulability              |
+------------------------+-------------------------------+
| Causes                 | - Placental hormones          |
|                        | - ↑Demand                     |
+------------------------+-------------------------------+

+------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Heart rate                   | ![](/content/exams/anzca/2018/B/5/prize-image001.jpg){fig-alt="Heart rate percentage change over gestation"}                   |
|                              |                                                                                                                                |
|                              | - ↑Uteroplacental demand → ↑venous return                                                                                      |

|                              | (Note: ↑HR occurs from \~4/40, not conception)                                                                                 |
+------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Stroke volume                | ![](/content/exams/anzca/2018/B/5/prize-image002.jpg){fig-alt="Stroke volume percentage change over gestation"}                |
|                              |                                                                                                                                |
|                              | - ↑Uteroplacental demand → ↑venous return                                                                                      |
|                              | - ↑RR and V~T~ → ↑respiratory pump                                                                                             |
|                              |                                                                                                                                |
|                              | (Note: ↑SV occurs a bit later than for heart rate)                                                                             |

| Cardiac output               | ![](/content/exams/anzca/2018/B/5/prize-image003.jpg){fig-alt="Cardiac output percentage change over gestation"}               |
|                              |                                                                                                                                |
|                              | - ↑Uteroplacental demand                                                                                                       |
|                              | - Note increased risk of heart failure                                                                                         |
+------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Systemic vascular resistance | ![](/content/exams/anzca/2018/B/5/prize-image004.jpg){fig-alt="Systemic vascular resistance percentage change over gestation"} |
|                              |                                                                                                                                |
|                              | - Progesterone, prostaglandins →                                                                                               |
|                              | - Smooth muscle relaxation                                                                                                     |
|                              | - Downregulation of α~1~ adrenoceptors                                                                                         |

|                              |                                                                                                                                |
|                              | - ↓↓Diastolic, ↓systolic, ↑pulse pressure                                                                                      |
|                              | - Due to ↓SVR with ↑stroke volume                                                                                              |

#### Blood:

+---------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Blood volume        | ![](/content/exams/anzca/2018/B/5/prize-image006.jpg){fig-alt="Plasma, total blood and red cell volume changes over gestation"} |
|                     |                                                                                                                                 |
|                     | ![](/content/exams/anzca/2018/B/5/prize-image007.jpg){fig-alt="Haemoglobin concentration over gestation"}                       |
|                     |                                                                                                                                 |
|                     | - Causes:                                                                                                                       |
|                     |   - Oestrogen → ↑RAAS → retain Na^+^, H~2~O                                                                                     |
|                     |   - Oestrogen → ↑Epo                                                                                                            |
|                     | - Implications:                                                                                                                 |
|                     |   - Iron supplementation aids erythropoiesis                                                                                    |
|                     |   - Hypervolaemic haemodilution improves tolerance of massive PPH                                                               |
|                     |   - Hypoviscosity aids increased cardiac output                                                                                 |
+---------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Interstitial volume | - Mucosal swelling, peripheral oedema                                                                                           |
|                     | - Causes:                                                                                                                       |
|                     |   - Oestrogen → ↑RAAS                                                                                                           |
|                     |   - Progesterone → vasodilatation                                                                                               |
|                     | - Implication:                                                                                                                  |
|                     |   - ? Fluid reserve in case of blood loss (no evidence for this)                                                                |
+---------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Plasma proteins     | - ↓\[Albumin\], ↔AAG                                                                                                            |
|                     | - ↓Oncotic pressure 14%                                                                                                         |
|                     | - Cause: progesterone → volume expansion → dilution                                                                             |
|                     | - Implication: ↑free % acidic drugs e.g. ↑risk thiopentone toxicity if GA LUSCS                                                 |
+---------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Hypercoagulability  | - ↑Factors I (2x), VII, VIII, IX, X, XII, vWF                                                                                   |
|                     | - ↓Protein S, acquired resistance to Prot C                                                                                     |
|                     | - Cause: oestrogen                                                                                                              |
|                     | - Implication: ↓risk lethal bleeding, ↑risk thromboembolism                                                                     |
+---------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

#### Regional circulations:

+--------------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Uterine blood flow | - 150mL/min → 750mL/min (80% uteroplacental, 20% other)           |
|                    | - Cause: ↑demand                                                  |
|                    | - Implication: potential for rapid bleeding                       |
+--------------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Other              | - Renal blood flow: ↑80%, mostly in T1                            |
|                    |   - Hence ↑urine output                                           |
|                    | - ↑Flow rate through skin, muscle, breast, GIT                    |
|                    |   - Hence faster onset of SC and IM drugs (e.g. opioid in labour) |
+--------------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------+

#### Labour:

+---------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Escalating cardiac output | ![](/content/exams/anzca/2018/B/5/prize-image008.jpg){fig-alt="Cardiac output changes during labour and postpartum"} |
|                           |                                                                                                                      |
|                           | - Intrapartum: effort + pain + distress (attenuated by epidural)                                                     |
|                           | - Post-partum: uterine involution → autotransfusion (highest risk of heart failure)                                  |
+---------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

#### Pathology:

+-------------------------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Supine aortocaval compression | - i.e. supine → ↓↓mAP                                             |
|                               | - Blood shunted to azygos systems                                 |
|                               | - Affects 15% patients                                            |
|                               | - From 20/40                                                      |
|                               | - Prevention: wedge under right hip during LUSCS or resuscitation |
+-------------------------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Pre-eclampsia                 | - Cause: ? abnormal invasion or spiral arteries by trophoblast    |
|                               | - Characterised by multi-system endothelial dysfunction           |
|                               | - Risk of hypertensive emergency and seizure                      |
+-------------------------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------+
